data.description_text:
Forterro is building the next generation of its enterprise data platform, and we're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer to help us do it.

We're moving away from our existing SQL Server and Azure Data Factory architecture and building a new centralised data platform in Databricks. You'll join at an important point in that journey, helping us ingest, transform and structure data from across Forterro and create reliable data pipelines that support reporting, analytics and wider business use cases.

This isn't a traditional BI or reporting role. We're looking for someone who is comfortable working directly in Databricks, can code confidently in SQL and Python, and has practical experience building and working with data pipelines.

You'll work closely with colleagues across IT, Data and the wider business, with a particular focus on data originating from enterprise systems such as NetSuite and Salesforce. Previous exposure to financial/ERP or CRM data would therefore be particularly useful.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain reliable data pipelines within Databricks.
Use SQL and Python to ingest, transform, clean and structure data from multiple source systems.
Integrate data from enterprise applications into Forterro's central data environment.
Develop data models and reusable data assets that support reporting, analytics and business decision-making.
Work with data from systems such as ERP/financial platforms and CRM applications.
Translate business and technical requirements into practical data engineering solutions.
Monitor and resolve data quality issues, helping ensure data is accurate, consistent and reliable.
Work collaboratively with data engineers and colleagues across IT, reporting and analytics.
Follow the engineering standards, methodologies and conventions established across Forterro's data engineering function.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Most importantly, you'll have hands-on commercial experience with Databricks. We're looking for someone who can come into the role already comfortable working with the platform rather than needing to learn it from scratch.

You'll also bring:
Practical experience working with Databricks and data engineering pipelines.
Strong SQL skills.
Practical Python coding experience.
Experience ingesting, transforming and preparing data from multiple source systems.
An understanding of data modelling and good data engineering practices.
Experience investigating and resolving data quality or integration issues.
The ability to work with both technical colleagues and business stakeholders.
A practical, organised approach to solving data problems and managing priorities.

Desirable experience

You don't need to have worked with every system we use. However, we'd particularly value experience with:
NetSuite or another financial accounting/ERP platform, particularly working with its data or reporting.
Salesforce or another CRM platform such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 or HubSpot.
Data reporting or analytics alongside your core engineering experience.
Broader exposure to data ingestion, data wrangling, data science or machine learning.
French language is also a bonus but not mandatory.

data.description_text:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and retain customers at scale. Unlike tools that just surface insights, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary AI capabilities, helping teams take action and improve customer experiences across marketing, support, and research.

As we scale globally, building reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure is a top priority. DevOps is a core pillar of our engineering strategy, and we are investing heavily in deployment pipelines, observability, and operational efficiency across all products.

Why This Role Matters

Our engineering teams deliver fast-moving, AI-driven products, and the backbone of their speed and reliability is solid infrastructure and automation. As a DevOps Engineer, you'll ensure our systems scale seamlessly, deployments happen without friction, and incidents are caught before they impact users. You'll enable our teams to move faster, focus on building features, and trust that the platform is rock-solid.

You'll be part of shaping the operational culture at Lucidya, where automation, reliability, and proactive problem solving aren't just buzzwords, they're outcomes we obsess over every day.

What You'll Do

Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes
Support cloud infrastructure management and automation using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as Grafana
Automate repetitive operational tasks and support development teams with infrastructure and deployment needs
Troubleshoot deployment, application, and infrastructure issues, identifying root causes and implementing solutions
Collaborate with engineers to improve system performance, reliability, and release processes
Follow security best practices across deployment pipelines, applications, and infrastructure
Participate in incident investigation and resolution, escalating complex issues when necessary
Contribute to documentation and continuous improvement of infrastructure workflows and operational processes

Day-to-Day You'll:

Deploy applications and support routine operations within Kubernetes environments
Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for new and existing services
Monitor system health, investigate alerts, and resolve common deployment and infrastructure issues
Support developers with application deployments, environment configurations, and infrastructure requests
Write and maintain scripts to automate repetitive operational tasks
Assist with infrastructure provisioning and configuration management
Collaborate with senior engineers to investigate complex incidents and improve system reliability
Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, and operational efficiency

Success Looks Like:

Reliable CI/CD pipelines with fewer deployment failures and smoother releases
Successful deployment and operation of containerized applications in Kubernetes
Faster identification and resolution of common infrastructure and deployment issues
Reduced manual operational effort through automation
Improved monitoring, logging, and visibility into application health
Effective collaboration with engineering teams and clear documentation of operational processes

First 90 Days

0-30 Days: Understand Lucidya's infrastructure, architecture, deployment workflows, tools, and operational practices. Become familiar with existing cloud environments and Kubernetes deployments
30-60 Days: Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, support routine deployments, troubleshoot common issues, and take ownership of smaller infrastructure tasks with guidance from senior engineers
60-90 Days: Successfully onboard 2-3 services onto the existing Kubernetes environment, with appropriate CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and health checks, collaborating with senior engineers where needed

Requirements

Who You Are

Experienced: You have 5-7 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or a related role
Hands-On: You have practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure
Proactive Problem Solver: You can investigate common technical issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions while knowing when to escalate complex problems

Curious & Growth-Oriented: You are eager to learn, improve existing systems, and develop your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and observability
Quality-Focused: You understand the importance of reliable deployments, infrastructure security, monitoring, and operational documentation

Technical Skills You'll Bring

CI/CD: Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or improving CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar
Containers & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes, including application deployments, configurations, and troubleshooting

data.description_text:
The role: deploying impact

Embedded with customer teams, you own an engagement from the first conversation to its first system in production, delivering value, and then you repeat, with impact that grows over time.

Embed: Work on site with operators and executives, and run each engagement like a venture inside the customer. 
Scope: Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into clear technical plans, and build first what creates most value. 
Build: Design and deploy production-grade AI systems powered by LLMs, on architectures built to scale. 
Drive adoption: Put systems in the hands of their users, measure the outcomes, and iterate until the impact is delivered. 
Shape direction: Guide enterprise teams through AI adoption and set the technical direction of each engagement. 

Where we align: AI and technology first

Engineering fundamentals: Expert proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and 8+ years building reliable production systems with modern DevOps practices. 
AI-native: Hands-on with modern LLM tooling such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Guardrails, MCP or agent frameworks, and a strong understanding of AI system evaluation, debugging and observability. 
Building AI systems: 5+ years building and deploying AI/ML and LLM-powered applications or AI agents in production, including RAG pipelines, tool use and multi-step AI workflows. 

Our values

Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly. 
Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix. 
Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible. 
Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet. 
Long-term builder: You invest in Echelon’s long-term success, bringing field insight back into our strategy and operations. 

The seat

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Package: A base salary with housing, transport and education allowances, medical cover, and equity through the employee equity programme. Terms are shared at the offer stage. 

How we work

You start from the problem, not the tool. You meet an unclear brief or a broken environment with energy and a plan.

Curiosity: You learn how the work really happens on site and keep learning as the stack moves. 
Speed: You move from brief to working code quickly and do not wait for perfect conditions. 
Rigour: You reproduce before you fix, test what you ship and can explain every choice. 
Confidence & humility: You challenge and accept challenge, and change your view on evidence, without ego. 
Autonomy: You decide with incomplete information and own it; from an outcome, you organise the work yourself. 
Resourcefulness: Missing access, partial data, an unfamiliar codebase: you find a way with what is available. 
Situational leadership: You lead when the moment calls for it, and follow when someone else has the better call. 
A force multiplier: Your reviews, patterns and documentation make the whole bench faster. 
AI-native depth: AI tools are part of how you write, test and debug code, and you have built something real with an LLM. 
Where you are: Principal level, with 8+ years of shipping and a record of leading complex deployments end to end; fluent in Python, TypeScript or similar.

About The Role

We're looking for a structured, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape and deliver digital financial products for a growing fintech startup. You'll own product direction and priorities, working closely with business, engineering, design and compliance to turn customer needs into practical, measurable product improvements.

The role covers the full product lifecycle, from discovery and strategy through launch and growth, with a focus on payments, digital wallets and BNPL.

What you'll do

Define and own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for your assigned product area, aligning customer needs with business objectives.
Lead customer discovery through user interviews, product insights, and market and competitor research, translating findings into clear problem statements and business cases.
Own and prioritise the product backlog, balancing customer value, business impact, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies and delivery effort.
Develop product requirements documents, user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering and design clear direction.
Define MVP scope and success measures, coordinating go-to-market planning, release readiness and post-launch improvements with relevant teams.
Partner with engineering and design on backlog refinement, sprint planning and delivery, resolving scope questions and managing product trade-offs.
Work with risk and compliance teams to incorporate applicable SAMA regulations, KYC and AML requirements into product design and delivery.
Define business and product requirements for API integrations with banks, payment providers and third parties, partnering with technical teams on implementation.
Establish product KPIs and contribute to OKRs, using funnel analysis, conversion, retention and other relevant metrics to evaluate performance.
Use customer feedback, product analytics and experiments, including A/B testing where appropriate, to guide prioritisation and continuous improvement.

Administer RHEL/Linux servers and application runtimes, including troubleshooting CPU, memory, disk I/O, process limits and application services.

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. 
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know Our Team
The Engineering department oversees all Agoda’s ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda’s business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. We work across structured and non-structured data at scale. For example, our current ML models process millions of images every day to try and enhance the experience that our users get from our app.

Why Agoda Engineering Team?
Our engineering team is at the intersection of Data Engineering, Business Analytics, ML Engineering, and Backend Engineering. We focus on software engineering related to processing big data, helping the Data Science team and Performance Marketing team launch experiments by providing our users with ML/data pipelines/platforms/tools to enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world. We are a small but passionate team with people from different nationalities working together on a single goal.
In this Role, you will get to:
Lead the team technically in improving scalability, quality, accuracy, speed, and efficiency of our existing Data and ML processes
Able to analyze data to help us make better decisions
Design/build/test tools, libraries, pipelines, and platforms to help Data Science and Business team to launch experiments in Production

Bachelor’s degree in computer science/information systems/engineering/related field

Expert in designing/writing/maintaining data pipelines and systems while ensuring data quality

Expert in software design/design patterns/best practices, functional programming and object-oriented programming.
Be comfortable navigating the following technology stack: Python3, Scala Spark, Hadoop, SQL, S3 etc.
Familiar with general Machine Learning concepts and common models - ie, regularization, Tree Models, etc
Familiar with statistical analysis concepts - ie, p-value, z-score, etc
Analytical problem-solving capabilities & experience.
A strong data-driven engineering driven mindset will be required to succeed in this role.

Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystems and Big Data architecture and technologies

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. 
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know Our Team
The Engineering department oversees all Agoda’s ML and software related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase Agoda’s business through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, ML driven solutions, queue systems and data monitoring tools. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the engineering team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the ML engineering squad, but also the reward. We work across structured and non-structured data at scale. For example, our current ML models process millions of images every day to try and enhance the experience that our users get from our app.

Why Agoda Engineering Team?
Our engineering team is at the intersection of Data Engineering, Business Analytics, ML Engineering, and Backend Engineering. We focus on software engineering related to processing big data, helping the Data Science team and Performance Marketing team launch experiments by providing our users with ML/data pipelines/platforms/tools to enable our company to validate strategic decisions, make smarter choices, and react to the fast-changing world. We are a small but passionate team with people from different nationalities working together on a single goal.
In this Role, you will get to:
Lead the team technically in improving scalability, quality, accuracy, speed, and efficiency of our existing Data and ML processes
Able to analyze data to help us make better decisions
Design/build/test tools, libraries, pipelines, and platforms to help Data Science and Business team to launch experiments in Production
Work with experienced engineers and product owners to identify and build tools to automate many large-scale data management / analysis / ML tasks
We believe in end-to-end ownership; this role will involve taking and building systems that enable us to launch experiments in production at a rapid pace
What You’ll need to Succeed:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science/information systems/engineering/related field
8+ years of experience in software engineering with at least 6+ years in data/ml engineering
Expert in designing/writing/maintaining data pipelines and systems while ensuring data quality
Expert in SQL, Python3, and JVM based programming language – ie, Java or Scala
Expert in software design/design patterns/best practices, functional programming and object-oriented programming.
Be comfortable navigating the following technology stack: Python3, Scala Spark, Hadoop, SQL, S3 etc.
Familiar with general Machine Learning concepts and common models - ie, regularization, Tree Models, etc
Familiar with statistical analysis concepts - ie, p-value, z-score, etc
Analytical problem-solving capabilities & experience.
A strong data-driven engineering driven mindset will be required to succeed in this role.
It’s great if you have:
Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystems and Big Data architecture and technologies
Experience with Scala/Scala Spark development
Working in an agile environment using test driven methodologies
Systems administration skills in Linux

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – C2 / C4I & Air Defense Systems

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, integrate, and test software solutions for Command and Control (C2), C4I, and Air Defense systems. The role involves developing secure, high-quality software, supporting system integration and testing, troubleshooting technical issues, and mentoring junior engineers.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and test software components using Java and/or C++.
Integrate software with sensors, data links, and external systems.
Develop automated tests and support CI/CD processes.
Participate in system design, code reviews, and technical documentation.
Troubleshoot defects and support system acceptance testing.
Collaborate with cross-functional Agile/Scrum teams and mentor junior engineers.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
6–7 years of software development experience, including 2–3 years in Defense, C2/C4I, Air Defense, or other mission-critical systems.
Strong programming skills in Java and/or C++.
Experience with system integration, networking protocols, databases, and software testing.
Familiarity with Linux, Git, CI/CD tools, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and teamwork skills.
Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance.

Senior DevOps Engineer
Full-time | Riyadh

We are partnering with a growing technology organisation to appoint a Senior DevOps Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure behind a rapidly scaling technology platform.

This is a hands-on role spanning cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, container platforms, security, observability and production reliability. You will work closely with engineering teams to create scalable, secure and resilient environments, while establishing the operational standards the wider technology function can build on.

Key Responsibilities
Design and maintain scalable, reproducible infrastructure using infrastructure as code.
Own CI/CD pipelines covering build, testing, security and production deployment.
Manage containerised workloads across Kubernetes and cloud-based compute environments.
Build safe deployment strategies with appropriate rollout, rollback and recovery mechanisms.
Manage cloud networking, API gateways, load balancing, DNS, certificates and service connectivity.
Implement identity, secrets management and least-privilege access across environments.
Operate production databases, including high availability, replication, backup and recovery.
Establish monitoring, alerting and operational metrics across infrastructure and applications.
Lead incident response and continuously improve reliability, security and operational resilience.
Optimise infrastructure utilisation and costs, including high-compute workloads.
Help create reusable platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to deploy and operate services independently.

What We're Looking For
8+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, infrastructure or platform engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with AWS, including compute, networking, IAM and storage.
Strong infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu, including reusable modules and state management.
Experience with Ansible or comparable configuration management.
Strong CI/CD experience, particularly GitHub Actions or equivalent.
Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes and Helm, with EKS highly desirable.
Experience with GitOps, including ArgoCD or Flux.
Experience with API gateways, authentication, routing and rate limiting.
Production experience with PostgreSQL, RDS/Aurora and Redis or equivalent technologies.
Experience with Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or Parameter Store.
Strong observability experience with Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry or equivalents.
Comfortable working in Linux environments with Bash and Python.
Strong understanding of security, reliability, incident management and production operations.

Advanced Infrastructure
Experience operating AI, machine learning or other high-compute workloads in production is highly desirable.

Relevant experience may include:
GPU infrastructure and workload scheduling.
Model-serving or inference platforms.
Autoscaling and capacity management for compute-intensive workloads.
Managing performance, utilisation and cost of high-compute environments.
Technologies such as vLLM, Triton, TGI, KServe, Ray Serve, Amazon Bedrock or SageMaker.

Senior Data Engineer
Full-time | Riyadh

We are partnering with a growing technology organisation to appoint a Senior Data Engineer to help build and scale its data platform.

This is a hands-on role with ownership across data ingestion, processing, storage, modelling and governance. You will build reliable data infrastructure used across multiple technical and business applications, while helping shape engineering standards as the platform evolves.

Key Responsibilities
Design, build and operate scalable batch and streaming data pipelines.
Develop data architecture across ingestion, processing, storage and transformation layers.
Build reliable, reusable datasets and data models for downstream applications and teams.
Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, lineage and governance.
Design for reliability through idempotency, deduplication, schema evolution, recovery and historical accuracy.
Implement appropriate access controls and protection for sensitive data.
Work closely with engineering and infrastructure teams to operate production data services.
Optimise performance, scalability and infrastructure costs.
Contribute to technical standards, documentation and code reviews.

What We're Looking For
8+ years of professional data engineering experience.
Strong Python and SQL skills, including PySpark or comparable distributed processing technologies.
Strong production experience with AWS data services, particularly S3, Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Athena and Redshift.
Experience designing and operating data lake or lakehouse architectures, including layered data transformation.
Experience with ETL/ELT and integration technologies such as Airbyte, Fivetran or Meltano.
Experience with streaming, event-driven or change-data-capture technologies such as Kinesis, MSK, SQS, SNS, DMS or Debezium.
Experience with dbt or comparable data transformation and modelling tools.
Familiarity with Parquet and modern table formats such as Iceberg, Delta Lake or Hudi.
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as MWAA, Step Functions, Dagster or Prefect.
Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and lineage.

data.description_text:
At Mirai, a Scopely Studio, we're passionate about creating engaging gaming experiences that delight millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, AI platform, who builds products and can see the platform inside them. You will write product features yourself, and you will turn what repeats across products into shared services and libraries the rest of the team builds on. The platform comes out of real product work, one product at a time, not ahead of it.

Our AI Native Engineering team builds software for Scopely game teams and internal departments: tools that use large language models (LLMs) for bug triage, player feedback analysis, market and company research, and contract analytics, alongside direct-to-consumer web stores for Scopely games. Most of these tools repeat one pattern: connect a source system, build a trusted store, put an LLM or governed logic over it, and control who can see what. Today each product builds that pattern its own way, with its own model setup, its own access rules, and its own safety controls.

This is a software engineering role, not an infrastructure role. Our DevOps and SRE engineers own clusters, pipelines, and cloud provisioning. If your recent work is mainly infrastructure with little product code, this is not the right fit.

What You Will Do

Build product features end to end on our internal AI tools, in TypeScript or Python, from design through production
Find what our products build separately and turn it into shared services and libraries: model access and spend, identity and permissions, retrieval, tool servers, and the controls around LLM calls. Move products onto them one at a time, without stopping delivery
Build MCP tool servers that expose company data to agents and chat tools, with the end user's permissions enforced before any data reaches the model
Help introduce relationship-based access control across products, so access rules are defined once and applied to both database queries and vector search
Standardize model access through our LLM gateway, so model choice, cost, and usage are set in one place rather than in each repository
Spread the safety patterns that live in one project each today to every product: prompt-injection handling, kill switches, sandboxed execution of generated code, and locked-down data access
Make the shared pieces easy to adopt: clear APIs, versioning, templates, and documentation another engineer can follow without asking you
Set the standard in code review, including for AI-assisted code, and mentor engineers through review, pairing, and design
Own incidents on what you build, and work with our DevOps engineers on how it is deployed and run

Requirements

What we are looking for 

Six or more years building and running production software, including at least one shared service, library, or internal API that other engineers or teams depended on
Strong TypeScript and Node.js, and strong Python. Our services are split across both
Shipped LLM features to production: retrieval over embeddings, tool calling, structured output, and a way of checking output quality
Designed APIs or libraries other engineers build on, with real attention to versioning, compatibility, safe defaults, and documentation
Built multi-tenant or permission-sensitive systems, and knows where to enforce access so data never reaches a user, or a model, that should not see it. Treats model output and retrieved content as untrusted input
Solid system design: service boundaries, data modeling, failure handling, idempotency, and cost
Production experience on AWS, with infrastructure as code in Terraform or similar, enough to own how your services ship alongside DevOps
Writes tests as part of the work and treats CI checks as gates, not suggestions
Clear written and spoken English, and able to explain technical tradeoffs to product and business stakeholders
Uses AI coding tools and verifies their output. You understand, can prove, and own what you merge

The Stack

Languages: TypeScript and Node.js, Python 3.11.

Services: Express, FastAPI, Next.js

AI: OpenAI models and embeddings, LangChain, access control with SpiceDB (designed, being introduced)

Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, an internal LLM gateway built on LiteLLM over Amazon Bedrock

Cloud and Delivery: AWS (EC2, ECS Fargate, Lambda,

Data: PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS and Aurora), BigQuery, Amazon OpenSearch Serverless for vector search

App Runner, S3, CloudFront), Terraform, GitLab and GitHub

Identity and Access: Okta, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, relationship-based access control with SpiceDB (designed, being introduced)

Work Tracking: Jira, Confluence

Nice to Have

Relationship-based access control in practice, with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or similar
An LLM gateway such as LiteLLM or Amazon Bedrock, and evaluation or tracing tools such as Braintrust, Langfuse, or LangSmith
An agent orchestration framework such as LangGraph
A shared platform that served several teams or departments rather than one product
Experience in games, or Arabic

Benefits

Mobile Phone Allowance
Health Insurance
Performance Bonus
Relocation support where applicable

data.description_text:
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer – Manual Testing & Application Monitoring to ensure the functional quality, technical stability, and reliability of our digital eCommerce platforms.
This role combines hands-on manual testing, API and integration testing, application observability, and production incident investigation. The successful candidate will validate complex transactional customer journeys, troubleshoot technical defects, monitor application health, and work closely with engineering teams and external development vendors to resolve customer-impacting issues.
The ideal candidate goes beyond executing predefined test cases. They can independently investigate application errors, interpret technical evidence, identify root causes or contributing factors, and communicate findings clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
Experience with Sentry is an advantage. Candidates with strong hands-on experience using equivalent application performance monitoring (APM) or observability platforms are equally encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities
1. Functional and Manual Testing
Design, develop, and execute functional, regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end test cases.
Validate complex web-based customer journeys, including registration, quotation, checkout, payment, and post-purchase transactions.
Perform cross-browser compatibility, responsive design, and mobile web testing.
Review business requirements, UX designs, and acceptance criteria to identify gaps and ensure adequate test coverage.
Document, prioritize, and track defects, supporting user acceptance testing (UAT), release validation, and production readiness.
2. Application Monitoring and Production Observability
Operate application monitoring and observability tools to investigate production issues across frontend, backend, API, and infrastructure layers.
Monitor application exceptions, failed transactions, API availability, latency, slow page loads, user-impacting errors, and performance regressions.
Investigate incidents by correlating exception stack traces, application logs, browser console and network evidence, distributed traces, session replays, release changes, and service health indicators.
Analyze incident severity, recurrence, frequency, and impact on customer journeys and business operations.
Maintain and improve monitoring dashboards, alert configurations, thresholds, incident classifications, and escalation procedures.
Validate monitoring coverage, monitor release health, and confirm that production fixes resolve the reported issues.
3. API and Integration Testing
Test REST APIs using Postman or equivalent tools, validating request and response payloads, authentication, status codes, and error handling.
Investigate HTTP errors, timeouts, unexpected responses, and integration failures.
Validate integrations between eCommerce platforms, payment gateways, core systems, and third-party services.
Use browser developer tools and relevant diagnostic evidence to investigate client-server communication issues.
4. Technical Troubleshooting and Incident Management
Act as a technical quality contact between business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external development vendors.
Reproduce production incidents and provide clear, evidence-based defect reports with steps to reproduce, logs, screenshots, network traces, and other relevant technical details.
Investigate recurring defects, identify likely root causes or contributing factors, and verify corrective actions.
Prioritize incidents according to customer impact, business criticality, and technical severity.
Support effective incident escalation and resolution in collaboration with engineering and application support teams.
5. Reporting and Continuous Improvement
Maintain QA execution reports, defect registers, incident investigation reports, and application stability reports.

data.description_text:
Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.

You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.

This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.

Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

Responsibilities

Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases
Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process
Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough
Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)
Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback
Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right
Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most
Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality
Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output
Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report
Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

Requirements

5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions
Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two
Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence
Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)
Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines 
Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one 
Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high
Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs
Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging and investigation
Practical experience using AI in your work, and the critical thinking to know when to trust it and when not to
A preventive mindset: you've fixed problems at their root, not just patched symptoms, and can give examples

You work side by side with our data and AI teams and turn their models into decisions buyers feel and merchants see in their sales.

Core Responsibilities:

Know Salla's buyers: how they shop across very different stores, and what makes them hesitate, compare, or leave. Bring their voice into every decision, along with the merchants whose sales depend on it. 
Own search, the product page, and reviews end to end, from discovery to iteration, tied to buyer conversion and merchant sales
Partner with data and AI teams on ranking, query understanding, and semantic search. Decide what ships, to which stores, and how you measure it
Design the product page around the buyer's decision: what they need to see, trust, and confirm before they buy
Build reviews that buyers trust and merchants can use, including for stores with few or no reviews
Experiment by default and Ship safely across thousands of stores: staged rollouts, experiments, guardrails, and a way back
Run continuous discovery: talk to buyers and merchants regularly, watch real sessions, and test ideas with prototypes before committing engineering time. 
Make decisions with data: define the metrics that matter for each surface, read the funnel yourself, and let evidence, not opinion, settle debates.

4-6 years of experience in Product Management, preferably owning Search, Discovery, Product Pages, Conversion, or other customer-facing product experiences within a live consumer or e-commerce product

AI-native mindset with hands-on experience using AI tools for data analysis, prototyping, research and interpreting product results

Strong understanding of Arabic Search and Discovery, including Arabic spelling variations, dialects, transliteration, Arabic-English mixed queries, and search behavior
Demonstrated ownership of product outcomes, with the ability to work independently, take initiative, and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
You simplify: you cut before you add

data.description_text:
Over 100,000 merchants run their businesses on Salla. The largest and most complex of them , holding companies, multi-brand groups, franchises, and cross-border operators , have grown into a level of operational complexity that calls for a dedicated enterprise layer: purpose-built capability on top of a platform that already runs their commerce.

This role owns that segment end-to-end. You will define what "enterprise" means at Salla in terms of needs, not labels: multi-storefront, multi-entity permissioning, headless and API-driven operations, reliability backed by service-level commitments, and merchants running several markets from one account. You lead a dedicated enterprise engineering pod as its one accountable product owner, and you feed into the commercial line: which capabilities justify the enterprise tier, and where the line sits. Few product roles let you define a segment, build it, and shape how it is priced at the same time. This one does.

You will need to hold one tension permanently: meet enterprise complexity through extensible platform capability, never through bespoke one-offs that fork the codebase.

You will drive impact across four major domains:

Enterprise Strategy and Packaging (segment definition, roadmap, tier gating, rate limits)
Delivery Through a Dedicated Pod (one accountable product owner from discovery to release)
Multi-Market Capability (multi-currency, multi-tax including ZATCA and Gulf equivalents, per-market payment rails, cross-border)
Agent and API Readiness (making enterprise merchants the proving ground for emerging agentic commerce protocols)

Responsibilities:

Own the strategy and roadmap for the enterprise segment, prioritized by retention and expansion impact, not feature count
Run deep discovery with enterprise merchants and convert organizational, business-model, and market complexity into an evidenced, defensible requirement set
Lead the dedicated enterprise engineering pod as its one accountable product owner: discovery, specification, prioritization, execution, release
Ship enterprise-grade capability: multi-storefront, headless and API-first operation, role-based access and approvals, reliability and performance at scale
Own the capabilities that let one merchant run multiple markets from one account: multi-currency, multi-tax compliance, per-market payment rails, cross-border operation
Feed capability and feature-gating decisions into enterprise packaging, including where rate limits sit
Guard against platform forking: meet enterprise needs through reusable capability, with domain teams retaining architectural review rights
Own enterprise success metrics with the data team: capability adoption, net revenue retention contribution, enterprise win rate, time-to-value for complex onboarding

Requirements

Proven ownership of an enterprise or top tier on a multi-tenant software or commerce platform, with the retention or expansion metrics you delivered
Deep hands-on fluency in at least two of: multi-storefront architecture, headless and API-first commerce, role-based access and approval systems, multi-currency and multi-tax operation
Track record converting messy enterprise discovery into prioritized requirements that engineering respected
Commercial packaging judgment: you have decided which capabilities gate a tier and where rate limits sit, and defended the line
Experience operating as the single product owner for a dedicated engineering pod across two-to-four-quarter horizons
A demonstrated bias for platform capability over bespoke delivery, with a real example of saying no to a large account
Strong analytical mindset, comfortable instrumenting segment economics per account
Six or more years in product management; exposure to agentic commerce protocols or building for AI agents is a plus
Full professional fluency in Arabic and English is required; Gulf market experience is preferred over theoretical knowledge. Willing to relocate to Saudi Arabia

We are hiring a Junior Software QA Engineer on behalf of our client. This is a fully remote, paid position for motivated individuals looking to build their careers in Software Quality Assurance and Software Testing.

The successful candidate will work closely with developers and product managers to test web and mobile applications, identify and document software defects, and help ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable products.

Key Responsibilities

Execute manual, functional, and regression testing for web and mobile applications.
Review business and technical requirements and translate them into detailed test cases and test scenarios.
Plan and execute test cases and accurately document testing results.
Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects using issue-tracking tools.
Perform regression testing to ensure new updates and fixes do not negatively impact existing functionality.
Re-test resolved defects and verify that issues have been successfully fixed.
Collaborate closely with developers and product managers to investigate, reproduce, and resolve software issues.
Perform exploratory and usability testing when required.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to QA activities throughout the software development lifecycle.

Maintain clear and organized QA documentation and test reports.

Good knowledge of software testing methodologies and QA principles.
Solid understanding of manual testing and the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
Experience creating and executing test cases and test scenarios.
